title: Update the list of available packages with zypper
summary: Refresh the local cache of available software so that you can install or upgrade to the latest versions.

steps.explain: Synchronize the list of packages and versions available from your configured repositories.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form 'ref' instead of 'refresh'.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for refreshing the package list; it simply updates the local cache with current repository data.
